Compatible with the eufy X8 Hybrid. Please confirm your vacuum model before ordering.
Made from selected microfibers, the pad performs better than the original material and will not scratch your floor.
The pad resists high temperatures, does not fade and leaves no lint. It dries easily and stays durable through repeated use.
As part of normal maintenance the pad can be taken off and swapped for a new one in seconds.
Change the mop pad every 2 to 3 months, depending on how often you use the robot, to keep performance at its best.
